title: Personal expense tracker
summary: Build a small command-line program that records expenses, saves them to a file and reports totals by category.

requirements.text: The user can add an expense with an amount, a category and a note.
The program can list all expenses and show the total for each category.
Expenses are saved to a file and loaded again when the program starts.
Invalid input, such as a non-numeric amount, shows a clear message and does not crash the program.
The code is organised into functions, and each function has a short docstring.
The README explains how to run the program and shows one example session.
